description: Odin, the God Father of Magsafe Powerbanks. This Magsafe powerbank is Qi2 certified, built to supercharge your devices faster than ever. Snap it onto your iPhone for 15 W Qi2 wireless charging that’s up to 2× faster, and 35 W PD wired charging to power your Apple iPhone or Google Pixel to 50% in just 30 minutes. Odin supports 15 W wireless fast charging for Samsung devices. Whether you’re fuelling your Samsung S22–S25 Ultra, Pixel, AirPods Pro, or more, Odin keeps your entire ecosystem fully charged with its 10,000mAh powerhouse capacity. The built-in Type-C cable delivers 3 5W output and 20W input, so you’re always ready- no extra cables required. Designed for effortless streaming and productivity, it features a sturdy stand to access StandBy Mode and a clear digital display so you can track power in real time. Compact, stylish, and proudly Made in India with BIS approval and CE RoHS certification , Odin is your ultimate charging companion for staying powered anywhere, anytime. *These Stuffcool Power Bank images are for illustration purpose only.
